summary: Iteration 4 verification of the money-safety fixes (A-H) plus B2B/B2C regressions. Rewrote /app/backend/tests/test_b2c_money_safety.py to assert the FIXED behaviour and updated 2 stale tests in test_b2c_individual.py. Full backend suite: 80/80 pytest tests pass (5 files, ~100s, xdist -n2). Frontend: verified landing B2C sections + CTAs, individual-marketer login, wallet '...' loading placeholders then correct 560/60/500 split, marketer copy-link (no runtime-error overlay, success toast), role guards (individual blocked from /packages, /packages/new, /sales; office blocked from /marketer; pricing hidden for individuals on /market), admin dashboard 'عدد الأفراد' + 'أرباح المنصة'.

verified_fixes.FIX_A_marketer_escrow: PASS - ref booking of 1300 pkg (net 1000, margin 300) puts marketer pending=60, available=0, total=60. Pending is NOT spendable (booking attempt with 0 available -> 400). settle blocked inside 24h grace so commission stays pending. After marketer spends own funds then buyer blue-cancels, wallet = available 40 / pending 0 (never negative).
verified_fixes.FIX_B_ledger: PASS - marketer_commission (+60) and marketer_commission_reversal (-60) rows present; wallet total reconciles to 0.
verified_fixes.FIX_C_no_self_referral: PASS - marketer booking with no ref and with own code => marketer_id null, commission 0, platform_profit 300 recorded. A different marketer's ref still credits 60.
verified_fixes.FIX_D_cancel_fees_recorded: PASS - blue cancel writes admin fee 20 (2% net) to platform_revenue (rows: +300 profit, -300 reversal, +20 fee => net 20). Yellow cancel-accept writes platform_cut 20 (10% of 200 deduction); seller_keeps 180.
verified_fixes.FIX_E_individual_p2p: PASS - office -> individual transfer returns 200 pending; funds move only after admin approval (ind available 10, sender 90); re-review returns 404 (no double credit); unknown email still 404.
verified_fixes.FIX_F_clipboard: PASS - copy-link-btn click on /marketer produced no webpack runtime-error overlay and showed the success toast; no pageerror captured.
verified_fixes.FIX_G_wallet_loading: PASS - first paint shows '...' in wallet-balance-total, then resolves to 560.00/60.00/500.00.
verified_fixes.FIX_H_landing_b2c: PASS - b2c-consumer / b2c-marketer sections and both CTAs present and navigate to /register; hero subtitle contains المكاتب والأفراد والمسوّقين.
verified_fixes.regressions: PASS - B2C charges final_sale_price*seats, seller net in pending, platform_profit=margin-commission logged; B2B debits net+10% fee, blue->yellow(mandatory visa numbers)->green, settle blocked <24h, blue-cancel refund, admin topup/transfer/withdrawal approvals and dispute resolution idempotent (double action rejected); issue-visas keeps a previously stored visa_file and rejects partial submits without flipping status.

minor.issue: Reviewing an already-reviewed transfer returns 404 'طلب التحويل غير موجود أو تمت مراجعته' instead of 409/400. Behaviourally safe (idempotent, no double credit) but the status code conflates 'not found' with 'already processed'. Test now accepts 400/404.

The 10% B2B platform_fee is deducted from the seller at settle but is never written to the platform_revenue collection, so the admin 'أرباح المنصة' figure understates B2B income (B2C profit, cancel admin fee and yellow platform_cut are logged). Reported for confirmation - not the previously-discussed double-commission design.

The visa_file-preservation branch is effectively unreachable: the handler validates all registrants before persisting, so a partial submit 400s and a second submit is blocked by status!=blue. Harmless, but the fix is dead code today.

issues: H1 still reads 'سوق B2B لتبادل باكجات العمرة والسياحة' and the features section says 'كل ما يحتاجه مكتبك' / 'صُممت خصيصاً لمكاتب السفر' - inconsistent with the new consumer/marketer positioning (only the hero subtitle is inclusive).
Label 'بريد المكتب المستلم' is office-only wording even though individuals can now receive transfers (FIX E).
Large amounts wrap the '$' symbol onto a second line (e.g. '1,516,655.00' + '$'), breaking card alignment.
Success toast renders at top-center overlapping the page title and its light-green-on-white text has weak contrast.

action_items: Optional: log the B2B platform_fee to platform_revenue at settle so admin revenue reflects B2B income.
Optional: return 409/400 (not 404) when re-reviewing an already-processed transfer/topup/withdrawal.
Copy polish: make landing H1 / features section and the P2P recipient label inclusive of individuals & marketers.
critical_code_review_comments: market.py create_booking / cancel_request / settle_booking perform multi-document money moves without a Mongo transaction; a crash mid-sequence (e.g. after buyer debit, before seller escrow) leaves inconsistent balances. Consider a session-based transaction or an idempotent compensation log.
market.py is ~380 lines but mixes packages, bookings, lifecycle and cancellation - split into market/packages.py and market/bookings.py before it grows past 700 lines.
wallet.py stores recipients under 'to_office_id/to_office_name' even for individuals; field naming will confuse future reporting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (landing, login, wallet, marketer copy, role guards, admin dashboard)

rca_of_the_issue: No new defects found. Previous overdraft was caused by crediting marketer commission to wallet.available at booking time; market.py now credits wallet.pending and only moves it to available in settle_booking, with a marketer_commission_reversal ledger entry on blue cancel, so a reversal can never exceed the pending amount.
